definitions.label: Toggle sidebar
definitions.description: Collapse or reveal the sidebar shell.

definitions.label: Add project
definitions.description: Open the Create project dialog to import a local folder.

definitions.label: Search projects and threads
definitions.description: Open the sidebar search palette from anywhere in the app.

definitions.label: Toggle Activity
definitions.description: Show or hide running tasks, completed work, and items that need attention.

definitions.label: Import thread
definitions.description: Bring an existing conversation into the current workspace.

definitions.label: Previous space
definitions.description: Switch to the previous project space and restore its last working context.

definitions.label: Next space
definitions.description: Switch to the next project space and restore its last working context.

definitions.label: New thread
definitions.description: Start a fresh thread in the current project, or the most recent one.

definitions.label: New thread in latest project
definitions.description: Jump back into the most recently used project with a new thread.

definitions.label: New chat
definitions.description: Open the empty chat landing view.

definitions.label: New terminal thread
definitions.description: Create a thread that opens directly into terminal mode.

definitions.label: New Claude thread
definitions.description: Start a fresh thread with Claude selected.

definitions.label: New Codex thread
definitions.description: Start a fresh thread with Codex selected.

definitions.label: New Cursor thread
definitions.description: Start a fresh thread with Cursor selected.

definitions.label: Split chat
definitions.description: Open the current conversation in a second pane.

definitions.label: Previous recent view
definitions.description: Cycle backward through recently opened primary views.

definitions.label: Next recent view
definitions.description: Cycle forward through recently opened primary views.

definitions.label: Model picker
definitions.description: Open the composer provider and model picker.

definitions.label: Next model
definitions.description: Cycle to the next model for the active provider (favorites first, then remaining models).

definitions.label: Previous model
definitions.description: Cycle to the previous model for the active provider (favorites first, then remaining models).

definitions.label: Next model effort
definitions.description: Cycle the model's available effort levels and briefly show the selected level.

definitions.label: Reasoning picker
definitions.description: Open the composer reasoning and trait controls.

definitions.description: Open Settings → Usage for provider quota and token totals.

definitions.label: Focus composer
definitions.description: Focus or blur the chat prompt composer.

definitions.label: Find in thread
definitions.description: Search the current transcript and jump to each matching message.

definitions.description: Open the workspace file-name search palette.

definitions.label: Search snippets
definitions.description: Open the workspace content search palette across file snippets.

definitions.label: Toggle terminal
definitions.description: Show or hide the terminal surface for the active thread.

definitions.label: Focus terminal
definitions.description: Open or focus the terminal panel for this thread.

definitions.label: Close terminal
definitions.description: Close the terminal session for this thread.

definitions.label: Toggle diff
definitions.description: Open or close the working tree diff panel.

definitions.label: Next change
definitions.description: Jump the diff viewport to the next changed file.

definitions.label: Previous change
definitions.description: Jump the diff viewport to the previous changed file.

definitions.label: Toggle side chat
definitions.description: Open or hide a side chat beside the main conversation.

definitions.label: Toggle browser
definitions.description: Reveal the built-in browser panel for the active thread.

definitions.label: Toggle iOS Simulator
definitions.description: Reveal the iOS Simulator panel for the active thread. macOS servers only.

definitions.label: Copy thread ID
definitions.description: Copy the active thread's ID to the clipboard.

definitions.label: Archive thread
definitions.description: Archive the active chat, with the same confirmation and undo as the thread menu.

definitions.label: Snooze thread
definitions.description: Open the snooze date and time picker for the active chat.

definitions.label: Mark thread unread
definitions.description: Mark the active chat unread and restore its dismissed notification.

definitions.label: Previous visible thread
definitions.description: Cycle to the previous thread that is currently visible in the sidebar.

definitions.label: Next visible thread
definitions.description: Cycle to the next thread that is currently visible in the sidebar.

definitions.label: Next chat needing attention
definitions.description: Open the most urgent other chat: one waiting on you first, then unseen work, as Activity's Priority ranks them.

definitions.label: Previous tab
definitions.description: Switch to the open thread tab on the left of the active one.

definitions.label: Next tab
definitions.description: Switch to the open thread tab on the right of the active one.

definitions.label: Close tab
definitions.description: Close the active open-thread tab, like a browser tab.

definitions.label: Open in favorite editor
definitions.description: Send the current thread or workspace target to your preferred editor.

definitions.label: Save file
definitions.description: Write the focused editor's unsaved changes back to disk.

definitions.label: Commit and push
definitions.description: Commit pending changes and push the active thread's repo.

definitions.label: Editor commands
definitions.description: Open the editor command picker for the focused code editor.

definitions.label: Rename symbol
definitions.description: Rename the symbol under the cursor across the workspace.

definitions.label: Go to definition
definitions.description: Jump to the definition of the symbol under the cursor.

definitions.label: Find references
definitions.description: List references to the symbol under the cursor.

definitions.label: Go to symbol in file
definitions.description: Jump to a symbol in the open file.

definitions.label: Go to line
definitions.description: Jump to a line, or line:column, in the open file.

definitions.label: Show problems
definitions.description: List diagnostics for the open file.

definitions.label: Quick fix
definitions.description: Show quick fixes and refactorings for the code at the cursor.

definitions.label: Start or continue debugging
definitions.description: Launch the debugger for the open file, or continue a paused session.

definitions.label: Stop debugging
definitions.description: Stop the current debug session.

definitions.label: Toggle breakpoint
definitions.description: Add or remove a breakpoint on the cursor line.

definitions.label: Step over
definitions.description: Run the next statement without entering calls.

definitions.label: Step into
definitions.description: Enter the next call.

definitions.label: Step out
definitions.description: Run until the current call returns.

definitions.description: Switch the workspace to the terminal tab.

definitions.description: Switch the workspace back to the chat tab.

definitions.description: Close the currently focused workspace panel or tab.
